Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
4. The Registrar Compliance of this Court is also directed to communicate this order to the District Judge, Farrukhabad for compliance of this order, henceforth.
